name: Emma Aaron Yakushiin
source:
"I'm saying this because of our situation! I'll deal with everything else, but at least let me have a bath!"

A quarter-European classmate of Itsuki's from a long line of doctors. With a pace all her own and a spoiled streak to match, she'd known him since before high school - taking it upon herself to make him her personal attendant and dragging him into whatever schemes crossed her mind.

Praise is what makes Emma tick - compliment her efforts and she'll beam with determination, showing a surprisingly earnest side beneath her privileged exterior. True to her medical heritage, she keeps her bag stocked with first-aid essentials, from disinfectant to bandages.

Life in the abandoned village? At first, she wouldn't lift a finger, declaring existence without proper baths "absolutely impossible!" Yet once she discovered how everyone praised even her smallest efforts, she started warming up to rough living - step by stubborn step.

[Translated from the [url=https://escude.co.jp/product/haison/chara04.html]official website[/url]]
